items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, Richie Cole, the young alto player.

ctx.x: Small group, before he joined you. Let's see, who told me that? Yeah, Richie Cole, the young alto player. Told me when Richie was with Buddy Rich's band, and he was out there in Atlanta City, and he heard Gregory Herbert playing the alto, and he wrote + said, 'Boy, listen to that guy, wow, that's what I want to do.' And I think he said, two or three days after -- several years with Buddy, he left, and did that. And he says, 'Ironically, Gregory joined Woody Herman.'
